citation.authors: Ballesteros-Torres JM, Vazquez-Aguilar A, Luzardo-Ocampo I, Escalante-Aburto A et al

cited_by.title: Ashwagandha: cortisol, mood, skin, hair, heart, kidneys and liver

record.population: 43 adults with overweight or obesity, Mexico (the abstract reports 17 control and 21 intervention)
record.design: Double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled pilot, 500 mg a day for 40 days with a monitored diet
record.finding: No significant change in weight, BMI or waist circumference. Triglycerides and VLDL cholesterol fell. The authors call for longer studies.
record.note: Pilot, 40 days. Participant numbers in the abstract do not add up to 43.
